subject.title: feat(ui): add message preview to session list

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a narrow Control UI Sessions-list last-message preview now, or fold it into broader Sessions overview work?
rationale: The backend and TUI already support last-message previews, but the paired feature issue is marked for maintainer/product review and the current branch needs a current-path repair before it can represent the product choice.

options.title: Sponsor Current-Path Repair
options.body: Repair or replace this PR against the current sessions page using `includeLastMessage` and `lastMessagePreview`, then require focused tests and real Control UI proof.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Overview
options.body: Keep the paired feature issue as the canonical UX discussion and ask that preview rendering land only as part of the broader Sessions overview design.

options.title: Defer Preview UI
options.body: Leave the Control UI sessions table as-is for now and close implementation attempts only after a maintainer states that direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Current-Path Repair
recommendation.body: Repair or replace this PR against the current sessions page using `includeLastMessage` and `lastMessagePreview`, then require focused tests and real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cross-surface Sessions work makes this the clearest available owner for the UI and gateway contract choice.
